verdict.rationale: Reducto's enterprise docs describe deployment options (dedicated VPC, hybrid VPC, fully hosted SaaS) where 'all data and storage reside in the customer's VPC,' giving some control over data location, but this is scoped to Enterprise-tier deployments rather than a self-service region-selection setting for standard AI-native users. Community feedback also notes a DPA (needed for EU residency compliance) is only available on the enterprise plan, reinforcing that residency control is gated behind higher tiers. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection UI or API parameter for standard/Growth tiers, documented list of supported regions/data centers, and independent verification of VPC deployment residency guarantees.
